item.title: Bo Bichette on first game action at third for Mets: ‘Just trying to figure out who I am over there’
item.description: Bo Bichette entered Saturday's Grapefruit League game eager to see what he was facing at third base.

item.title: Mets taking it slow with Brett Baty after early hamstring issue
item.description: A week into his spring training, Brett Baty has been limited only to taking defensive reps at first base.

item.title: Stinky sewage seeps throughout Yankees’ Steinbrenner Field: ‘It’s spring training for the toilets, too’
item.description: Saturday was not the first time Steinbrenner Field had a sewage problem.

item.title: Eric Dane’s girlfriend Janell Shirtcliff pays tribute to late actor
item.description: Photographer and director Janell Shirtcliff shared a tender glimpse at her relationship with Eric Dane following his death on Thursday from ALS.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 22, 2026
item.description: There's no need to be sharp with one another. Fiery Mars leaps into a supportive sextile to healing Chiron, encouraging us to make the first move in mending strained bonds of any type. This is furthered by the affectionate trine between fond Venus and lucky Jupiter at 3:01 pm EST, inviting us to give and receive appreciation in equal measure. Creative solutions could be necessary for any remaining tension, which means we've got permission to have fun with the process of figuring things out.

item.title: Queens man who strangled landlady over unpaid rent gets 22 years in prison
item.description: Prosecutors said that on Dec. 4 around 7:30 p.m., the landlady and teen tenant got into an argument over unpaid rent that turned physical, with Vidal strangling the victim with his hands and a cord from an iron.

item.title: Ghislaine Maxwell’s brother shows support for ex-Prince Andrew following his arrest
item.description: Ghislaine Maxwell's brother extended his sympathies to former Prince Andrew after the ex-royal was arrested on Thursday.

item.title: Homeless man accused of stealing woman’s cane outside NYC Target is a scofflaw sex offender
item.description: A homeless man accused of stealing an elderly woman's cane outside a Manhattan Target in a violent struggle was ordered held on bail Saturday afternoon after his arraignment in Manhattan Criminal Court.

item.title: Cops release photos of suspect in fatal shooting of panhandler in Manhattan 7-Eleven
item.description: The suspect shot Mark Jackson, 43, in the neck inside the 7-Eleven on Feb. 12, cops said. The two had reportedly been quarrelling about who would hold open the store's door for change.

item.title: Asking Eric: Introduction of a child changes dynamic for longtime housemates
item.description: Dear Eric: My 40-year-old daughter has been living in a house with a very nice older, recently retired gentleman for about 10 years. He has an adult son and daughter-in-law who are drug addicts. Recently, because of domestic violence in front of their 4-year-old child, the daughter-in-law was arrested and has an order of protection […]
